title: record-figure
description: The numbers one figure of the solar-weather record states, worked out by the engine (crates/vleo-modules/src/record.rs). A number the record cannot give is null, never a stand-in.

anyOf.description: The density figure: how the two drivers a density model takes sit against each other.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

days.description: Days carrying both F10.7 and Ap.

r.description: Pearson correlation of F10.7 with Ap; null under three days or with no spread.

below_both_pct.description: Per cent of those days below both medians.

storm_ap.description: The daily Ap at or above which a day is a storm day.

storm_deciles.description: How many of the ten F10.7 deciles hold at least one storm day.

anyOf.description: The storm-scale figure: how storms are shared out between the cycles the record holds.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

levels.description: G1 to G3, each with its daily-Ap threshold: the published table's ap at Kp 5, 6 and 7.

cycles.description: The cycles, in the record's table order.

days.description: Days in each cycle carrying an Ap.

max_ap.description: The largest daily Ap in each cycle; null for a cycle with no days.

per_year.description: Days a year at or above each level, per cycle: [level][cycle].

evenness.description: The busiest cycle's G1 rate over the quietest's; null unless two cycles reach G1.

busiest.description: The cycle with the most days a year at each level; null where none has a rate.

anyOf.description: The Kp-against-Ap figure: the daily Ap at each worst three-hourly Kp, beside the published table.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

kp.description: Every worst-slot Kp the record holds, ascending.

table.description: The published three-hourly ap at each Kp; null off the scale.

above_median.description: At how many of those Kp the table is above the median day.

kp7_median.description: The median day at Kp 7; null where the record has none.

anyOf.description: The recurrence figure: the autocorrelation of the detrended record against lag, over F10.7 or Ap.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

max_lag.description: The longest lag, in days; the curves run from lag 1 to it.

windows.description: The three detrend windows in days; the first is the one the rows were measured under, and the band and peaks are read off it.

r.description: The autocorrelation at every lag, one curve per window: [window][lag − 1]; null below three pairs.

n_lag1.description: The pairs behind the first window's correlation at lag 1.

band.description: Bartlett's 95 per cent half-width on the first curve, at every lag.

outside.description: At how many lags the first curve is outside the band.

peak_lag.description: The first curve's peak lag in 18–36, 45–65 and 72–95; null where there is none.

peak_r.description: The correlation at each of those peaks.

above_long.description: At how many lags the longest window's curve sits above the first's.

compared.description: At how many lags both are drawn.

anyOf.description: The spike figure: the F10.7 days the smooth cycle does not explain, and where in the cycle they fall.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

threshold.description: The ratio to the 81-day centred mean at which a day is a spike: the ratio's mean plus 2.5 standard deviations.

days.description: Spike days that have a cycle phase.

bursts.description: The separate runs of consecutive spike days they fall in.

phase.description: The centre of each phase bin.

rate.description: Spike days per thousand days at each phase; null where the record never reaches it.

anyOf.description: The mean-cycle figure: every cycle stacked on phase, the mean of the complete ones, and how well the last two complete cycles repeat.

bundle.description: The bundle and version the numbers were worked out from.

min_days.description: The fewest days a bin must hold in both compared cycles to count toward the correlation.

phase.description: The centre of each phase bin.

cycles.description: The cycles, in the record's table order.

complete.description: Whether each cycle is complete; the one still running folds by the mean length of the others.

curves.description: Each cycle's mean in each bin: [cycle][bin]; null for an empty bin.

mean_cycle.description: The mean over the complete cycles of their bin means.

pair.description: The two cycles compared — the last two complete — earlier first.

r.description: Their correlation over the bins both fill; null under three.

above.description: In how many the earlier cycle runs above the later.

gap_rise.description: The mean of earlier minus later before phase 0.6.

peak.description: The two cycles' largest bin means.
